newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks jump in early trade, helped by NCB.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks jump in early trade, helped by NCB.

text.p: Tokyo stocks jumped in early morning trade on Thursday, supported by buying in financial and property-related issues after news that Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) and Bankers Trust New York Corp are in the "final stages" of talks on a business tie-up, brokers said.
By 0020 GMT, the key 225-share Nikkei average had gained 197.62 points or 1.12 percent to 17,900.99. Its June futures rose 210 points to 17,920.
